scope: Explicit programmatic shared SDK document selection and a reproduced live receive repair; not complete UI or durable-session integration.

contract.entryPoint: createSharedDocumentEditor(raw), or SharedRichEditor<document-v1> with explicit selectionEditing document-v1
contract.immutablePolicy: The selected observer/view/recovery family lasts for the facade lifetime; ordinary caret selection does not downgrade it.
contract.types: New SharedDocumentView/SharedDocumentSelection and generic publication types; original SharedView/RichSelection/default constructor remain closed.
contract.recovery: restoreSharedDocumentEditor selects only the caller-declared document explicit/natural factory with no old/general fallback.
contract.oldDefaults: Default constructors refuse document-family native owners; existing DOM/storage interfaces do not accept the new typed facade.

nativeReceiveRepair.defect: The live receive path used candidate.selection(), which intentionally rejects Document; replay already used selection_for_mapping().
nativeReceiveRepair.expectedFailure: Queued remote while the whole document is selected was refused; contract violation: use explicit document selection family.
nativeReceiveRepair.fix: Live receipt uses the internal scope mapper; public original getters remain strict.
nativeReceiveRepair.regression: In both history modes, live receipt retains Document, newly observed peer roots enter subsequent Copy/replacement, duplicate frames are no-ops, old observations stale, and exact restored Undo recovers the full observed document.

existingSharedNativeRegressionBaseline.scope: Original selection, general ranges/flow/Enter, semantic history and typing. The subsequent one-line live document-scope repair was checked by the new focused native case and rebuilt real-Wasm probes.

actualSdkReleaseWasm.scope: Explicit programmatic shared SDK observer/view/Copy/replacement/first-key typing/recovery and real queued remotes. Original defaults stay closed. Durable session/storage, DOM/React, rich whole-document paste and document presence/toolbar integration remain incomplete.

actualPairedReleaseWasm.scope: Direct paired release Wasm scope/Copy/deletion/plain and first-key typing, hidden-only documents, exact explicit/natural recovery, and actual previous-runtime offline peer with owned root visibility edits. SDK/storage/DOM document routing, whole-document rich paste and composition remain required. No release acceptance inferred.

remainingForDocumentSelection: Whole-root rich paste and explicit post-paste caret/floor policy
Immutable declared local/shared durable storage and recovery handoff
Local SDK and DOM/React Select All, painting, input/Enter/composition and Copy/Cut/paste
Explicit document-scope presence and toolbar behavior without widening old protocols
remainingForGoal: Finish document selection end to end
Separate sanitized HTML/Markdown and realistic Word/Docs/Excel interchange with explicit losses
